text.en: 1. This Order is the Active Mobility (Non‑Compliant Vehicle Use — Exemption) Order 2018 and comes into operation on 1 May 2018.

heading.en: Exemption from section 19(1)(a) and (c) of Act

text.en:
3.—(1) Section 19(1)(a) of the Act does not apply to an individual who rides on any footpath or shared path within a public park, a non‑compliant bicycle that is rented from a specified person.
(2) Section 19(1)(c) of the Act does not apply to an individual who rides on any footpath or shared path within a public park, a non‑compliant personal mobility device that —
(a)is non‑motorised; and
(b)is rented from a specified person.

THE SCHEDULE
Specified persons
Paragraph 2
1.Coastline Leisure Pte Ltd (UEN 201136309C)
2.GoCycling Pte Ltd (UEN 201620037R)
3.Spring Gear (UEN 53064508D)
